title: Context-Aware Prompt Injection Detection via Small Language Models in RAG Pipelines: nokast-secureRAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.28364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Local Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection and retrieval poisoning, where malicious instructions in retrieved content are mistaken for trusted input. We present nokast-secureRAG, a roughly 0.5B-parameter small language model that acts as a semantic firewall between retrieval and generation. It jointly evaluates the user query and retrieved context, classifying the pair as safe, suspicious, or malicious. The model is trained using a teacher-judge-student pipeline: a 35B teacher generates 5,233 examples across four attack families, and an independent 120B judge re-labels them, achieving 95.0% agreement before student fine-tuning. On a held-out in-distribution test set, the model achieves 0.994 detection recall at a 0.026 false-positive rate and a 0.006 attack-success-rate proxy, outperforming a regex baseline, a public prompt-injection classifier, Llama Guard 3 1B, and its untuned versi

translated_title: 基于小型语言模型的RAG流水线上下文感知提示注入检测：nokast-secureRAG
translated_abstract: 本地检索增强生成（RAG）系统容易受到间接提示注入和检索投毒攻击，即检索内容中的恶意指令被误认为是可信输入。我们提出了nokast-secureRAG，一个约5亿参数的小型语言模型，作为检索与生成之间的语义防火墙。它联合评估用户查询和检索到的上下文，将这一对内容分类为安全、可疑或恶意。该模型采用“教师-裁判-学生”流水线进行训练：一个350亿参数的教师模型生成涵盖四类攻击族的5,233个样本，再由一个独立的1200亿参数裁判模型重新标注，在学生模型微调前达到了95.0%的一致率。在留出的分布内测试集上，该模型实现了0.994的检测召回率，误报率仅为0.026，攻击成功率代理指标为0.006，性能超越了正则表达式基线、公开的提示注入分类器、Llama Guard 3 1B以及其未微调版本。
tldr: 该论文提出了nokast-secureRAG——一个约0.5B参数的小型语言模型，作为RAG流水线中检索与生成之间的语义防火墙，通过教师-裁判-学生训练流水线实现上下文感知的提示注入检测，在误报率仅0.026的情况下达到0.994的检测召回率，优于多种现有防护方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces nokast-secureRAG, a ~0.5B-parameter small language model acting as a semantic firewall in RAG pipelines, which achieves context-aware prompt injection detection through a teacher-judge-student training pipeline, reaching 0.994 detection recall at only a 0.026 false-positive rate and outperforming existing defenses.
